newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T considered mutual acquisition - paper.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T considered mutual acquisition - paper.

text.p: B.A.T Industries Plc last year considered buying mutually-owned life insurance companies National Provident Institution, National Mutual Life or Scottish Equitable, according to a report in the Independent newspaper.
The paper said the three were named in a strategic review prior to the launch last July of British American Financial Services, under which B.A.T's financial services operations are now grouped.
However, the paper said B.A.T had cooled on the acquisition plans, partly because it was not clear a purchase would improve its sales to independent financial advisers.
